Add a computer
Persona works on your computer for you: reading files, running commands, using Claude Code there. Connect one first; Mac, Windows and Linux all work.
On that computer, open Persona on the web, go to Machines and choose Add computer. Follow the steps to install Persona Link; it connects by itself.
Once the computer connects, this updates by itself.

What Persona can do
Persona is your personal assistant. With a computer and a model connected, it can:
• Read files and run commands on your computer for you (it asks before it acts)
• Look at your calendar, mail, Lark and inbox, sort things out and draft replies
• Remember what you talked about and pick it up next time
How to connect a model
Persona needs a working model to answer. Pick one of two ways:
• You have an API key: in Settings › Model providers, pick a provider and paste the key. It\'s tested for you.
• You already use Claude Code: sign in once on that computer, nothing else to fill in.
